topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I can't believe I have to sort through this mess. Up in the attic, where the light barely reaches, boxes and stacks of who-knows-what are just sitting there, relics of lives long gone from this house. Every creak of the old floorboards under my feet echoes like a reminder. This isn't what I signed up for. The previous owners left without a word, their stuff abandoned, as if the space itself was meant to hold onto their secrets. I have to go through it all, sift through the useless junk, and decide what stays and what goes. It's suffocating, the silence, the weight of it all. I just want it to be over.
